name: Aurena Auktionen
notes: SSR page embeds a full JSON state dump in <script id=bidware-state> using custom entities (&q; for ", &a; for &, &l;/&g; for <>) instead of real HTML escaping; decode those first. Each item is a whole multi-lot auction (start=bidding opens, end=bidding closes), not a single ticketed event. Covers all of Austria plus some CH/DE consignors, not Vienna-only, so district/city/address are frequently null (only ~2% Vienna, ~58% have any location at all - rest are shipping-only 'Versandauktionen'). price_min always null: no per-auction price, only per-lot bids not exposed here.
